system.description: You inject a mixture of lead and mercury into a fresh corpse.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and it rises as a Moderate minion.
outcomes.success: The corpse rises as a Weak minion (a zombie). It believes it is still alive, though it smells faintly of chemicals and its skin is cold. It counts toward your minion limit.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the corpse twitches once and is still.
outcomes.ruin: It rises, knows it is dead, and blames you: it is a Weak foe. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
